meta.description: Act 1 earns one of four constrained revelations, then ends in withdrawal or a pending Act 2 petition.

1.0.label: threshold
1.0.text: you came carrying either an absence or an intention. neither gives me permission. choose the pressure you will use first.

2.1.label: wound_pressure
2.1.text: loss is not evidence that i possess what is gone. press me for the limit, or stake your claim on knowing it already.

choices.label: tell me what you are, and where you fail

handoff_start.revelation_text: intention gives the Voyd purchase on the unfinished present, while genuine release starves that purchase.
handoff_start.terms_constraint: any offer must preserve genuine release as an available end to the Voyd's pressure and cannot promise retrieval.

choices.label: submit your mechanism to what i already know

handoff_start.revelation_text: the Voyd stores no completed life or earlier self; intention may reach a pivotal moment only to reweave the resulting present amid competing wills and collateral change.
handoff_start.terms_constraint: any offer must name forward reweaving of the present, never backward travel, retrieval, or a stored life.

2.2.label: hunger_pressure
2.2.text: wanting makes you recruitable, not chosen. i have always opened when intention pressed against me. decide which answer you will force before you disclose a desire.

choices.label: name yourself without hiding the hook

handoff_start.revelation_text: the identity called possibility is a recruiting lure: its image is proposed, not a person or outcome stored for recovery.
handoff_start.terms_constraint: any offer must identify the image as a proposed future and may grant only one disclosed, bounded use of that lure.

choices.label: say what you want from my intention

handoff_start.revelation_text: the Voyd recruits sustained intention because a living plan feeds it, but it cannot erase competing wills or collateral consequences.
handoff_start.terms_constraint: any offer may apply one bounded pressure to the unfinished present and must leave competing wills and consequences intact.

revelation.di.label: revelation_demanded_identity
revelation.di.text: then use my true edge. intention gives me purchase only on what remains unfinished. i cannot return an event or retrieve a life. keep directing the future and i can feed through that direction. release it genuinely and the purchase ends. that is where i fail.

choices.label: carry the starvation rule to the threshold

revelation.ck.label: revelation_claimed_knowledge
revelation.ck.text: test the distinction. no completed life, dead person, or earlier self waits inside me. intention may reach a pivotal moment and reweave the present that follows. it does not travel backward. every competing will and collateral consequence remains able to answer the change.

choices.label: carry the falsifiable distinction to the threshold

revelation.dm.label: revelation_demanded_motive
revelation.dm.text: i recruit intention kept alive. grief fades; a plan keeps pressing against me. that pressure feeds me. even then i can move only the unfinished present. i cannot erase another will, an existing obligation, or the consequences outside your desired result.

choices.label: carry the appetite and its limit to the threshold

revelation.ib.label: revelation_identity_as_bait
revelation.ib.text: call me possibility if you need a name. the name is bait. it makes a proposed future resemble something preserved and waiting. nothing is stored here for you. exposing the hook makes the image easier to refuse, and any later offer must leave it exposed.

choices.label: carry the disclosed lure to the threshold

threshold.di.label: revelation_threshold_demanded_identity
threshold.di.text: you have the rule that can starve my purchase. leave with it, or seek a concrete present change under that rule.

threshold.ck.label: revelation_threshold_claimed_knowledge
threshold.ck.text: you can now name the false mechanism when it is offered. leave with that distinction, or seek a concrete present change that survives it.

threshold.dm.label: revelation_threshold_demanded_motive
threshold.dm.text: you know what your continuing intention feeds and what my pressure cannot cancel. leave with that knowledge, or make me oppose a concrete change.

threshold.ib.label: revelation_threshold_identity_as_bait
threshold.ib.text: the lure has lost its disguise. leave with the hook exposed, or seek a concrete change without pretending its image is stored.
